title: Bounded FMC falling-slug to groundwater-front merge comparator
purpose: Test the published falling-slug/groundwater-front contact and merge transition against R16 and admitted R2 after D17 retained simultaneous but strictly separated FMC surface and groundwater branches.

predecessor_authority.D12: FMC/SMVE equation authority; 200 moisture bins and <=10 s explicit process step frozen.
predecessor_authority.D13: FMC groundwater-front branch retained candidacy versus R2 for G25/G50/G75/G125.
predecessor_authority.D14: Eq.19 falling-slug translation preserves slug length under the frozen 10 s process step.
predecessor_authority.D15: Exact-contact slug/groundwater finite-volume merge primitive passed accounting preflight.
predecessor_authority.D17: Simultaneous surface plus groundwater operation retained candidacy while all occupied intervals remained separated.
predecessor_authority.implication: D18 changes no constitutive, bin, time-step, capillary-relaxation or groundwater-front equations. It qualifies only the previously excluded contact/merge transition.

primary_source_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51, 4282-4300
retained_semantics: falling slugs advance first using published Eq.19 and preserve their length
a falling slug that encounters a groundwater front during a time step is merged with that groundwater front
the merged groundwater front is raised toward the surface by exactly the length of the merged slug in that water-content bin
groundwater-front motion uses published Eq.21 and capillary relaxation remains finite-volume mass conservative
primary_source_authority.excluded_inference: D18 does not invent geometric overlap subtraction, empirical contact-time correction or a post-contact tuning factor.

initial_state.groundwater_fronts: H_j=lambda*abs(psi(theta_j)), using the four already-qualified D13 lambda values.
initial_state.separation_requirement: 0 < top_j < bottom_j < 160-H_j < 160 for every active bin before execution.
initial_state.rationale: The half-step gap is defined solely from the already frozen Eq.19 velocity and 10 s step. It guarantees an encounter in the first FMC translation step without using SWAP outcomes.
initial_state.exact_SWAP_mapping: For each R16/R2 cell, theta is the exact finite-volume average of baseline plus falling-slug and groundwater occupied intervals, with no overlap at t=0; pressure head is obtained from inverse B01 retention.

bottom.SWAP: bottom mode 5, prescribed bottom pressure head 0 cm
bottom.FMC: fixed water table at z=160 cm with D13 Eq.21 groundwater-front dynamics

first_step_order: advance every falling slug by Eq.19 for one 10 s step; slug length remains invariant
for every bin whose translated slug bottom reaches or passes the pre-step groundwater-front top, remove that slug
increase that bin groundwater-front height H_j by exactly the invariant slug length; this is the published finite-volume merge rule
require merge storage before/after to agree within 1e-14 cm; do not subtract geometric overshoot
advance all resulting groundwater fronts with D13 Eq.21 forward Euler for the same 10 s process step
apply D13 conservative capillary relaxation to groundwater-front heights
compute bottom-outward exchange as negative groundwater-connected storage change excluding the internal slug-to-groundwater transfer
require global column water ledger <=1e-12 cm
subsequent_steps: no falling slugs remain after the designed first-step merge
advance groundwater fronts with the unchanged D13 Eq.21 plus conservative capillary relaxation
bottom-outward exchange equals negative column storage change

checks: all initial H_j, slug tops and slug bottoms are finite and strictly physical for M25/M50/M75/M125
initial slug and groundwater intervals are disjoint in every active bin
initial finite-volume storage maps to R16 and R2 cell averages within 1e-12 cm
all 99 falling slugs in each history encounter the pre-step groundwater front during process step 1
published merge raises each H_j by exactly 5 cm and removes the corresponding slug
after Eq.21 and capillary relaxation every groundwater front remains finite, positive, <=160 cm and monotone
all 64 FMC steps complete with no clipping or fallback
max absolute per-step global mass residual <=1e-12 cm
internal_preflight_before_SWAP_trajector.failure_rule: Any failure closes D18 before R16/R2 trajectory generation. No lambda, slug length, gap fraction, bin count, substep or merge semantics may be retuned inside D18.

SWAP_comparators.numerical_authority: D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth research policy with hard accepted-transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm; no production tolerance change.
SWAP_comparators.initialization: exact cell-average mapping of the frozen D18 finite-volume initial state

positive_rule: internal preflight passes before SWAP trajectory exposure
all M25/M50/M75/M125 FMC/R16/R2 histories complete with integrity
FMC all-step mapped 16-cell theta RMSE <= R2
FMC all-step terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and FMC sign-error count <= R2
FMC transition-window total-storage, cumulative-bottom-exchange, mapped-theta and terminal-bottom-flux RMSE are each <= matched R2

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain FMC as a broad hydraulic research candidate spanning groundwater, surface redistribution, separated composition and contact/merge. Next consider purpose-specific longer-horizon validation or rainfall/ponding threshold evidence before formal runtime.
successor_logic.if_negative: Do not retune D12-D17 discretization or merge semantics. Restrict candidacy to the already positive non-contact envelopes and diagnose the failed transition view.
successor_logic.formal_performance: Still deferred until contact/merge and at least one longer hydrological horizon are retained.
